resources.string: Open HMG-Seogaemo with the head-unit user button.
The head-unit user button opens HMG-Seogaemo.
The original button assignment is restored.

While enabled, Open HMG-Seogaemo replaces the current head-unit user-button assignment (for example, com.mobis.intent.action.CONNECTIVITY_SHORTCUT). HMG-Seogaemo reapplies this assignment after restarts and overrides choices made in stock button settings while enabled. Turn this module off to choose another function. Disabling restores the exact original assignment, replacing any intervening choice. This action does not appear in the stock button settings list.
